sourceMode: Extracted from the lossless sheets corresponding to the two user-selected boss JPEGs. No new image generation.
conversion: Per-actor fixed block sampling, binary alpha threshold 0.4, no dither, 28 opaque colours, anatomy-aware registration, component-separated FX. Native pixel masters can be edited without resampling.
paletteNote: Game crow/plant colours plus two dark petal midtones (#473344,#68435f) and game moon colour (#e9e6d6).
